high_level_description: The image shows two women taking a selfie in a bathroom mirror. The woman on the left has long, dark hair and is wearing a beige crop top paired with a black satin skirt that has a high slit on one side. She is also wearing black leather gloves and has her hands resting on her hips. The woman on the right has shoulder-length dark hair and is dressed in a form-fitting black dress with a high slit on one side. She is holding a pink smartphone with a white case, which she uses to take the selfie. She is also wearing a gold bracelet on her left wrist and has a tattoo on her left forearm.
